auth.title: Sign-in
auth.login.title: Sign in with Telegram
auth.login.lead: Scan the code with your phone’s camera, or open Telegram on this computer.
auth.login.leadPhone: Remember the number below, open Telegram and tap it in the bot.
auth.login.headline: Your whole business in one calm place.
auth.login.subline: Tasks, sales, cash, people and pay for every branch, live.
auth.login.feature.tasks: Every task with its photo proof
auth.login.feature.money: Sales, cash and expenses that add up
auth.login.tapHint: Tap only this number. Never tap a number someone sends you.
auth.login.steps.title: How it works
auth.login.step1: Scan the code, or press Open in Telegram
auth.login.step2: In the bot, tap the number shown here
auth.login.approvedHint: One moment while we open your dashboard.
auth.login.denied.title: This sign-in was cancelled
auth.login.denied.body: A different number was tapped in Telegram, or someone pressed “It wasn’t me”. Nobody was signed in.
auth.login.expired.title: The code expired
auth.login.expired.body: Codes last 3 minutes. Get a new one and try again.
auth.login.noAccess.title: No access to the dashboard
auth.login.noAccess.body: This Telegram account isn’t an owner or manager with dashboard access. Ask the company owner to give your role access.
auth.login.unavailable.title: Telegram sign-in isn’t set up yet
auth.login.unavailable.body: The server has no bot connected for sign-in. Ask whoever runs it to add the owner bot.
auth.login.throttled.title: Too many attempts
auth.login.throttled.body: Wait a minute, then get a new code.
auth.login.offline.title: Can’t reach the server
auth.login.offline.body: Check your connection and try again.
auth.dev.title: Developer sign-in
auth.dev.body: Sign in as any Telegram account in the development database. Works only on a DEBUG backend with DASHBOARD_DEV_LOGIN on.
auth.dev.invalidId: Enter a Telegram id: digits only
